description.title: I. Description
description.beforeLink: Slenderman's Scavenger Hunt is a multiplayer online game inspired by
description.betweenLinks: with the playability of the traditional game of scavenger hunt. The mobile-optimized website uses
description.players: Players enter a username and join a room (up to 5 players). Using their phone's camera, they scan objects to get location hints in this augmented reality scavenger hunt with a creepy Slenderman theme.

design.title: II. Design & Evolution
design.intro: We designed a simple, intuitive layout specifically for mobile devices:
uiFlow: Page Found: visual confirmation when scanning succeeds
Win Screen: shown to the highest scoring player
Lose Screen: shown to other players

testing.title: III. User Testing
testing.process: We tested with campus community members familiar with the environment. Testers included Professor Mathura Govindarajan and IM Lab Manager Ume Hussain.
feedback: Positive: enjoyable gameplay and attractive aesthetics
Issue: some ML5.js model detection glitches
UI improvement: make the top-right button more noticeable
Suggestion: add sound effects for found pages

future.title: IV. Future Improvements
expansion: Enhanced Slenderman theme with jumpscares and music
Improved UI for the info button
technical: Retrain ML models for better accuracy

tech.title: V. Technical Implementation
steps: Separate training page with model saving

team.title: VI. Team Reflections
team.fatemaQuote: I really enjoyed every part of this project... While we planned a different idea at the beginning, I think the fact that we ended up with a game that is mostly in person but still uses sockets as required by the class was our greatest accomplishment.
team.fatemaFocus: Focus: Socket.io implementation, game logic, entry page design.
team.fatemaChallenges: Challenges: room-specific socket data, win/lose screen consistency, balancing gameplay.
team.andresQuote: This project was equally stressful and enjoyable to do... I know this is only the tip of the machine learning's iceberg, but for me, it was a great achievement to understand its basic concepts.
team.andresFocus: Focus: ML5.js implementation, game visuals, model training.
team.andresChallenges: Challenges: model accuracy, colour vs B/W page detection and
team.next: Next: continue developing the game as a campus community-building activity.
